title: Kissed Quinoa Bowl with Malaysian Roasted Vegetables
description: A vegetarian Chinese-inspired bowl filled with quinoa, roasted vegetables, and a hint of Malaysian spices.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables (carrots, bell peppers, zucchini)
ingredients.notes: any combination of colorful vegetables works well

instructions: 2. Toss mixed vegetables with 1 tsp sesame oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
3. Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
4. In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, and sambal oelek.
5. In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, roasted vegetables, and sauce. Toss to combine.
6. Top with roasted peanuts and kissed sesame seeds.
